summary: Accreditation, an 18 plus specialty centre and a WhatsApp line are strengths, but mismatched page details and a booking promise with no booking form appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The FAQ says you can book online via the website, but no booking form appears, and the feedback section shows only a SUBMIT button with no visible fields.
findings.cost: A patient who wants to book online has no way to do it and may call a competitor.
findings.fix: A real booking form with doctor and time choice.

findings.problem: The email link is written mailto:mailto:info@reyadamedicalcentre.com and the phone link contains a space, tel:+974 4445 7777.
findings.cost: Tapping to email or call can fail on a phone.

findings.problem: The dermatologist's photo is described as Dr. Ahmed Al Mansoori, Specialist Cardiologist, a service image is labelled Orthodontics, and a review calls the centre Reyada Hospital.
findings.cost: Wrong labels confuse patients and weaken search visibility.
findings.fix: Correct descriptions and one consistent name.

findings.problem: Five testimonials show no dates or surnames, the accreditation dates conflict, and the page uses both Medical Center and Medical Centre.
findings.cost: Mixed dates and thin proof reduce trust in a medical brand.
findings.fix: Verified dates and named, dated reviews.

redesign: A booking form with doctor and time choice plus WhatsApp.
Tested call and email links on every page.
Consistent names, correct labels and dated reviews.
